data.name: Malik
data.gender_notes: Malik is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root م-ل-ك (m-l-k), 'to own, rule'. Malik means 'king, owner'. Its root is م-ل-ك (m-l-k). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Malik). Malik is a Arabic name meaning “King; owner; sovereign”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Malik expresses “King; owner; sovereign”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root م-ل-ك (m-l-k), 'to own, rule'. Malik means 'king, owner'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malik total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
